name: Stasis Seal
displayText: Exhaust a Unit. It does not Ready during its controller's next Ready Step.

notes: "It" is the Unit you just Exhausted. You choose once, and both sentences act on that same Unit.
A Unit that was already Exhausted is still sealed: the first sentence simply has nothing to do.
The seal survives this Spell going to your discard pile — it is fixed onto the Unit, not maintained by the card.
